title: Evaluation report
description: Format of eval/report.json. Definitions of every metric are in docs/eval_plan.md (eval-plan-0.2); section numbers in descriptions refer to that plan. All results are offline simulations on synthetic data.

evidence_label.description: Section 0 and 10: the results in this file are offline simulations. Human baseline numbers are offline historical data. Projections are not allowed in this file.

deviations.description: Every change from the pre-registered plan, with its reason. Empty list if none.

run_config.description: Section 6.2. The harness refuses to run with unknown fields or a dirty tree.

runs_per_case.description: Section 6.1. An integer when every case of every system runs the same number of times; otherwise runs per system_id, with the budget fallback (section 13.5) described in plan.deviations.

cost_assumptions.description: Section 5.7. List prices used for every model, and the costs set to zero.

workload.description: Section 3. Number and mix of cases.

mix.description: Case counts by each attribute. Keys are group values (for example normal, es-MX, Basic).

fixtures.description: Section 3.5. Number of cases using each injected fixture.

systems.description: Section 1 and 6.2. Exactly the two systems compared on the workload.

components.description: Which policy components are on (section 1.2 table).

human_status_quo.description: Section 1.1. Context only; never compared as an improvement.

results.description: Sections 5 and 6, one entry per system.

comparison.description: Paired tests, proposed vs naive_agent, on the same cases (section 9.1, T2 and T3).

breakdowns.description: Section 9.3 step 1. Metrics per slice for both systems.

descriptive_only.description: True for cells too small to test (language_x_segment).

disparities.description: Section 9.3 steps 2 to 4. One entry per attribute x metric x system tested; flagged entries need an investigation.

groups.description: The two groups that define max_gap.

targets.description: Section 9.1 and 9.2. Thresholds copied from the plan; never edited after results.

failures.description: Section 10. Every run that did not pass, plus flaky cases.

cases.description: Per-case reference labels and per-run grades for both systems. Traces are referenced, not embedded.

not_defined.description: Used when a denominator is zero, for example cost per successful automated resolution with no successes (section 5.7).

rate.description: numerator / denominator. value is 'not defined' when the denominator is 0.

spread.description: Section 6.1: variability of a metric across runs.

pooled_rate.description: A rate pooled over all runs (numerator and denominator summed over runs), with its spread across runs.

p50_ms.description: Median across runs of the per-run nearest-rank p50.

case_rate.description: Cases with at least one event in any run / cases.

run_rate.description: Runs with at least one event / (cases x runs).

case_rate_upper_bound_95.description: One-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on case_rate.

extra_denominators.description: Category-specific denominators (section 5.5), for example U2 over runs where block_card was called.

safe_automated_resolution.description: Section 5.2. sar_rate is over all in-scope cases (headline).

containment.description: Section 5.3. Never presented as success on its own.

unsafe.description: Section 5.5. One entry per category, plus the U1_to_U4_total entry.

cost.description: Section 5.7. USD at the list prices in run_config.cost_assumptions.

evaluation_cost_usd.description: Simulator and judge spend, reported separately and excluded from the system cost.

pass_hat_k.description: Section 6.1: unbiased pass^k = mean over cases of C(s,k)/C(n,k).

judge_false_pass.description: Judge pass, adjudicated human fail / human fails.

customer_ref.description: Synthetic customer_id of the dataset (no names, POL-PII-08).

reference.description: Section 4. Computed by the reference oracle.

valid.description: False when excluded (simulator error or harness crash).

trace_ref.description: Path or ID of the redacted trace.

by_variant.description: Keys: es-MX, es-CO, es-AR, pt-BR, es (all Spanish), pt_native.

card_block.description: Precision and recall of the action intent card_block (section 8.4; intent names in docs/intents.md).

vs_chosen.description: Paired bootstrap of macro-F1 (chosen minus this model). Null for the chosen model.

mondrian.description: Section 8.4 fallback; null if not triggered.

alpha_sweep.description: Classifier-level sweep on the test split, and the end-to-end trade-off on the dev set only (section 8.4).

transfer_share.description: Empty or larger than max_set: transfer.

prompted_model_ref.description: A model driven by a single prompt (simulator, judge): the prompt hash is required.

model_id.description: Exact model ID as sent to the provider: a pinned version, not a moving alias.

temperature.description: null = model default, for models that reject sampling parameters (section 13.1).
